facts.fact: Actum Sudan reports, citing the minister, that the state's 1,300 sq m Khartoum data centre was reactivated after rehabilitation, with cloud computing and data protection, to host government systems and serve public and private institutions and citizens.

systems.platform: cloud computing, data protection, AI application support
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications

note: Document also says RSF occupied Khartoum data centres in Feb 2024; no for-hire facility named.
